review_candidates.title: Corporate IT Operations Lead
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Administrator / IT Operations Lead to join our Corporate IT team. This position is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of a hybrid Microsoft Azure and on-premises enterprise network supporting over 400 users across multiple locations. As the organization continues to grow, this position is expected to evolve into an IT Department Manager responsible for leading the Corporate IT organization.
eligibility_evidence: This position is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of a hybrid Microsoft Azure and on-premises enterprise network supporting over 400 users across multiple locations.
________________________________________ Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Coordinate and lead a team to 3 to 5 IT professionals to manage the company’s hybrid (Cloud + on-prem) infrastructure.
• Lead, administer and maintain a hybrid Microsoft Azure Active Directory and on-premises Active Directory environment.

Experience must include: • Hybrid Microsoft Azure Active Directory and On-Premises Active Directory administration • Microsoft GCC High environments • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint • Microsoft Entra ID • Conditional Access Policies • PowerShell scripting • Azure administration • Microsoft Sentinel
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: • Ensure a security posture that complies with CMMC Level 2 and NIST 800-171 as well as meets the requirements of ISO 9K, 20K and 27K. Education Bachelor's degree in one of: • Information Technology • Information Systems • Information Management ________________________________________ Required Experience Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible experience in a senior IT infrastructure or systems administration role supporting an enterprise environment of 400 or more users.
